prompt: Review a proposed change that replaces the guarded React import at the top of packages/experimental/Avatar/ios/AvatarViewManager.swift with a plain `import React`.

assertions.description: Flags the unguarded Swift React import and keeps the #if canImport(React) guard required for iOS bridging-header builds.
Plans validation through an iOS host in both module and bridging-header modes rather than desktop Storybook, reporting unrun Office checks.
